summary: Turn a small open EEG dataset into a reproducible, uncertainty-aware answer to a bounded scientific question.
outcomes: Deliver a complete data-to-claim analysis with defensible preprocessing.
Show robustness and limitations in a compact research report.
sequence: Choose a question and licensed deidentified data subset
Inspect raw data, event timing and metadata
Publish a local reproducibility package and interpretation

visual.question: Can another learner verify every step behind the conclusion?
visual.interaction: Switch raw/processed traces, exclusion decisions and alternative valid analyses.

practice.task: Build the full local report with a negative control and held-out analysis.
practice.success: Another learner can rerun it; figures, statistics and conclusions remain linked to provenance.
